Book D2 (no 1h trend filter, 60-min timer, trend at entry recorded) with 3 changes from the Nov 2 loss review: (1) CONFIRMATION ENTRY - no resting limit fills; price must wick into/through the level on a 1m candle that closes back on the trade side (the wick must reach within 0.03% of the level or through it, the level-side wick must be at least as long as the body, and the close must be back above the level and its open for longs / below both for shorts), and the entry is at market on that close (next bar open, taker + slip); no absorption filter. (2) MIN STOP - stop at least 0.30% from the fill (structural stop kept if wider); size is cut so a stop-out still costs $0.75. TP stays 1R but must fit before the first liquidity (nearest of the leg extreme and the next 15m swing / PDH-PDL that price has not yet traded through, fronted 0.02%); if 1R does not fit the setup is skipped and logged as a near-miss. (3) BREAKEVEN - once the trade has gone +0.75R in favour, the stop moves to entry + round-trip fees + stop slippage (true scratch); the move is journaled. Base geometry: Top-5 most volatile (mean 1h range, last 24h) of the 15 most liquid HL perps (24h notional), re-ranked hourly, BTC excluded. FIB pullback at a flipped level (5m legs, 7d, 0.15% tol, stop beyond the level/0.886), limit entry. Slippage = 2bp + half the live spread. TP 1R, 30-min time stop, max 2 open at once. | R:R PRIORITY (all books, Nov 2 13:20): at entry the bot computes expected net R = (distance to the first liquidity [nearest untaken 15m swing / PDH-PDL, or the FIB leg extreme], fronted 0.02%, minus entry+TP fees) / (stop distance + entry fee + stop fee/slip). Setups under 1.2R net are skipped ('low R'); no liquidity in the 3d lookback scores 3.0 ('open'). Entries that trigger in the same 1-minute cycle are ranked by net R across all coins and the best fills first; if a cap/position limit then binds the others are logged 'outranked'. For this HEIST-EXIT book the TP IS the pre-liquidity level, so net R is the real target R.
